text: Trễ có vài phút thôi mà, đâu có nghĩa là mình không quý buổi này đâu.
sample: Just because I'm late doesn't mean I don't care about our time together.
note: Classic deflection pattern — pushes back without denying the fact.

text: Ông đó ít nói vậy thôi chứ đâu phải không có gì để nói.
sample: Just because he's quiet doesn't mean he has nothing to say.
note: Same pattern, different content — practice re-filling it fast.

text: Cậu không có quyền tự ý làm lại cái này mà không hỏi qua cả team đâu.
sample: You have no right to redo this without asking the team first.
note: Blunt boundary-setting — pairs well with a softer follow-up sentence.

text: Anh đâu có quyền tự tiện vào đây mà không báo trước với em.
sample: You have no right to come in here without telling me first.
note: Same structure, higher stakes — notice it still sounds natural, not textbook.

text: Ít ra cậu cũng phải nói một tiếng trước khi lấy đồ của tớ chứ.
sample: The least you could do is tell me before you take it.
chunk: the least you could do is ___
note: Signals a minimum expectation that wasn't met.

text: Ít ra bên anh cũng nên báo trước một tiếng khi bị trễ tiến độ chứ.
sample: The least you could do is give us a heads-up when things slip.
chunk: the least you could do is ___
note: Works just as well in a professional register.

text: Tệ lắm thì cậu quay về làm công ty bình thường thôi, cứ liều thử đi.
sample: The worst that could happen is you go back to a normal job, so just try it.
chunk: the worst that could happen is ___
note: Reframes risk as small — a go-to encouragement pattern.

text: Tệ lắm thì họ từ chối, mình ngại xíu rồi thôi.
sample: The worst that could happen is they say no and I feel awkward for a second.
chunk: the worst that could happen is ___
note: Same reassurance move, lower stakes.

text: Em rất muốn nhận việc này, nhưng đang ngập trong đợt release đến thứ Sáu rồi.
sample: I'd love to, but I'm slammed with the release until Friday.
note: Polite decline that keeps the door open.

text: Tớ cũng muốn đi lắm, nhưng mai bay sớm nên không dám liều đâu.
sample: I'd love to, but I've got an early flight I can't risk.
note: Same soft-no shape for a casual context.

text: Không phải làm remote giết chết văn hóa công ty đâu, mà là chẳng ai chịu bỏ công xây dựng nó thôi.
sample: It's not that remote work kills culture, it's that nobody puts in the effort to build it.
note: Reframes the cause instead of flatly disagreeing.

text: Không phải tớ giận cậu đâu, tại hôm nay tớ mệt quá thôi.
sample: It's not that I'm mad at you, it's that I had a rough day.
note: Corrects a wrong assumption gently.

text: Chỉ ra lỗi thì có gì sai đâu, dù đó là thiết kế của sếp đi nữa.
sample: There's nothing wrong with pointing out a flaw, even if it's someone senior's design.
note: Normalizes an action the listener feels unsure about.

text: Xem phim mà khóc thì có gì sai đâu, vậy mới là phim hay.
sample: There's nothing wrong with crying at a movie — that means it was good.
note: Same reassurance shape, everyday context.

text: Giờ mà thêm một framework nữa để bảo trì thì đúng là thứ cuối cùng team cần.
sample: The last thing we need right now is another framework to maintain.
note: Signals something is not just unhelpful but actively unwelcome.

text: Giờ mà có thêm người để phối hợp nữa thì đúng là thứ mình không cần chút nào.
sample: The last thing I need right now is more people to coordinate with.
note: Same pattern, personal-life content.

text: Cứ mỗi lần yêu cầu đổi giữa sprint là team lại phải làm lại gần nửa việc.
sample: Every time requirements change mid-sprint, we end up redoing half the work.
note: States a recurring cause-and-effect pattern, not a one-off complaint.

text: Lần nào đến quán đó cũng phải đợi bàn dài cổ.
sample: Every time we go there, we end up waiting forever for a table.
note: Same recurring-pattern shape, casual tone.

text: Thà mình từ từ hiểu cho kỹ còn hơn học nhanh rồi quên sạch.
sample: I'd rather take my time and actually understand it than rush through and forget everything.
note: States a clear preference by contrasting the alternative.

text: Thà tự nấu còn hơn trả gấp đôi cho cùng một món.
sample: I'd rather cook myself than pay double for the same meal.
note: Same preference structure, lighter stakes.

text: Vấn đề không nằm ở cái lỗi gõ nhầm đâu, mà là do team đẩy mọi người sang hệ thống mới quá nhanh.
sample: It's less about the typo and more about how fast we pushed people onto the new system.
chunk: it's less about ___ and more about ___
note: Redirects focus from the surface cause to the real one.

text: Không hẳn là do số lượng xe đâu, mà là đường xá chưa bao giờ được thiết kế để chịu tải như vậy.
sample: It's less about the number of cars and more about how the streets were never designed for this.
chunk: it's less about ___ and more about ___
note: Same reframing move applied to a bigger topic.

text: Không phải tại cậu đâu, chỉ là tuần này công việc rối tung lên thôi.
sample: It's not you, it's just been a chaotic week at work.
note: Softens a possible offense by naming the real cause.

text: Không phải mình né đâu, chỉ là chưa biết bắt đầu từ đâu thôi.
sample: It's not that I'm avoiding it, it's just I don't know how to start.
note: Same softening shape, more personal stakes.

text: Càng đào sâu vào thì càng phát hiện thêm nhiều trường hợp ngoại lệ.
sample: The more we dig into it, the more edge cases we keep finding.
note: Shows two things scaling together — a natural way to explain scope creep.

text: Càng đi tập thì mình lại càng muốn đi tiếp.
sample: The more I go, the more I actually want to keep going.
note: Same pattern, describes a positive feedback loop instead.

text: Chỉnh chuốt cái demo mà chẳng ai xem thì có ích gì đâu.
sample: There's no point in polishing a demo nobody's going to see.
note: Shuts down effort that no longer serves a purpose.

text: Cả hai đứa đang mệt thế này thì cãi nhau chuyện này cũng chẳng để làm gì.
sample: There's no point in arguing about this when we're both exhausted.
note: Same shape, de-escalates instead of criticizing.

text: Có tài thật đấy, nhưng không vì thế mà cách anh ta đối xử với người khác bớt tệ đi.
sample: The fact that he's talented doesn't change how badly he treats people.
note: Concedes one point while refusing to let it excuse another.

text: Cậu xin lỗi rồi đấy, nhưng không có nghĩa là nó hết đau.
sample: The fact that you apologized doesn't change that it hurt.
note: Same concession-without-surrender shape, personal stakes.

text: Tính năng có tốt đến mấy thì với chỉ hai kỹ sư cũng không thể ra mắt được.
sample: No matter how good the feature is, we can't ship it with two engineers.
note: States a hard constraint that quality alone can't fix.

text: Anh ta có duyên đến mấy thì mình cũng không hẹn lần hai đâu.
sample: No matter how charming he is, I'm not giving him a second date.
note: Same pattern, holds a decision firm despite a counterpoint.

text: Cứ năm phút là mình lại không kìm được phải kiểm tra điện thoại.
sample: I can't help but check my phone every five minutes.
note: Names an involuntary habit — action you do despite yourself.

text: Dù không thích công ty đó nhưng mình vẫn phải công nhận thiết kế của họ đẹp thật.
sample: I can't help but admire how clean their design is.
note: Same pattern for a grudging compliment.

text: Cuối cùng cũng chịu tăng lương cho team, đáng lẽ phải sớm hơn rồi.
sample: It's about time they gave us a raise.
note: Relief that something overdue finally happened.

text: Cuối cùng cậu cũng chịu xóa cái app đó đi, sớm phải thế chứ.
sample: It's about time you deleted that app.
note: Same pattern, lightly teasing tone.

text: Nói sếp mới tệ thì hơi quá, nhưng đúng là làm việc thiếu tổ chức thật.
sample: I wouldn't go so far as to say he's bad, but he's definitely disorganized.
chunk: I wouldn't go so far as to say ___, but ___
note: Softens a harsh label while still being honest.

text: Nói buổi tiệc hôm qua dở thì hơi quá, chứ đúng là khá chán.
sample: I wouldn't go so far as to say it was terrible, but it was pretty boring.
chunk: I wouldn't go so far as to say ___, but ___
note: Same diplomatic hedge, lower stakes.

text: Suy cho cùng thì khách hàng chỉ cần nó chạy được là xong.
sample: At the end of the day, the client just wants it to work.
chunk: at the end of the day, ___
note: Cuts through debate to the thing that actually matters.

text: Suy cho cùng thì chỉ cần nó hoàn thành việc là được, tranh cãi làm gì.
sample: At the end of the day, it just needs to get the job done.
chunk: at the end of the day, ___
note: Same refocusing move, applied to a broader debate.

text: Thẳng thắn với thô lỗ là hai chuyện khác nhau đấy nhé.
sample: There's a difference between being honest and being rude.
note: Draws a line between two things people often mix up.

text: Bận rộn với thực sự hoàn thành công việc là hai chuyện khác nhau.
sample: There's a difference between being busy and actually getting things done.
note: Same distinction, workplace framing.

text: Góp ý thì được, nhưng lôi ra bêu trước mặt cả team lại là chuyện khác.
sample: It's one thing to leave feedback, but it's another to call it out in front of everyone.
chunk: it's one thing to ___, but it's another to ___
note: Concedes the first act is fine, draws the line at the second.

text: Trêu riêng thì không sao, nhưng đùa vậy trước mặt bạn trai mình lại là chuyện khác.
sample: It's one thing to joke about it alone, but it's another to do it in front of him.
chunk: it's one thing to ___, but it's another to ___
note: Same escalation pattern, personal context.

text: Không phải lỗi tại cậu đâu, chỉ là đáng lẽ mình nên kiểm tra lại kỹ hơn.
sample: I'm not saying it's your fault, I'm just saying we should've double-checked.
chunk: I'm not saying ___, I'm just saying ___
note: Walks back an implication before it causes a fight.

text: Không phải code tệ đâu, chỉ là cần thêm test thôi.
sample: I'm not saying the code is bad, I'm just saying it needs more tests.
chunk: I'm not saying ___, I'm just saying ___
note: Same softening move, professional context.

text: Chỉ có cách duy nhất kịp deadline là QA phải bắt đầu từ hôm nay.
sample: The only way we hit the deadline is if QA starts today.
note: States a single hard condition, not a vague hope.

text: Chỉ khi nào lương gấp đôi thì mình mới chuyển thành phố thôi.
sample: The only way I'd move is if the job paid double.
note: Same pattern, personal decision framing.

text: Nếu rút ra được một điều, thì đó là chạy theo hype không trả được hóa đơn đâu.
sample: If there's one thing I've learned, it's that hype doesn't pay the bills.
chunk: if there's one thing I've learned, it's that ___
note: Classic story-closing move — turns an anecdote into a lesson.

text: Nếu có một điều mình rút ra được, thì đó là hợp đồng rõ ràng cứu được mọi mối quan hệ làm ăn.
sample: If there's one thing I've learned, it's that clear contracts save every relationship.
chunk: if there's one thing I've learned, it's that ___
note: Same reflective close, applied to a different lesson.

text: Ra mắt nhanh mà chẳng ai cần đến thì có ý nghĩa gì đâu?
sample: What's the point of shipping fast if nobody actually needs it?
note: Questions effort that misses the real goal.

text: Mua cả đống đồ tập mà không bao giờ dùng thì mua làm gì?
sample: What's the point of buying all that gear if you never use it?
note: Same pattern, everyday nudge instead of a work critique.

text: Theo mình thấy thì refactor sau khi ra mắt chỉ tổ làm gấp đôi công sức thôi.
sample: The way I see it, refactoring after launch just doubles the work.
note: States an opinion as a considered view, not a fact.

text: Theo mình thì sáng tạo phụ thuộc vào con người, chứ không phải chỗ làm việc.
sample: The way I see it, creativity depends on the person, not the office.
note: Same framing, staking out a personal take.

text: Với mình thì scope nhỏ lại còn hơn là ra mắt trễ.
sample: As far as I'm concerned, a smaller scope beats a late release.
note: A firmer, more settled version of 'the way I see it'.

text: Với mình thì chuyện đó quên luôn rồi, khỏi bận tâm.
sample: As far as I'm concerned, it's already forgotten.
note: Same pattern, closes the topic for good.

text: Chuyến đi có khả năng bị mưa đấy, nhớ mang theo phương án dự phòng nhé.
sample: There's a chance the trip gets rained out, so bring a backup plan.
note: Flags a possibility without overstating it.

text: Có khả năng đợt migrate này sẽ làm hỏng mấy báo cáo cũ đấy.
sample: There's a chance this migration breaks the old reports.
note: Same hedge, used to raise a risk early.

text: Chắc cũng có người làm rồi đấy, nhưng không có nghĩa là cậu không nên thử.
sample: Chances are someone's already tried it, but that doesn't mean you shouldn't.
note: A stronger, more confident cousin of 'there's a chance'.

text: Chắc anh ta không đến đâu, ghét mấy vụ này lắm.
sample: Chances are he won't come — he hates those events.
note: Same pattern, a confident guess based on what you know.

text: Tớ cũng chẳng muốn nói vậy đâu, nhưng cái này phải viết lại từ đầu thôi.
sample: I'd hate to say it, but this needs a full rewrite.
note: Softens bad news by naming the reluctance first.

text: Tớ cũng chẳng muốn hủy kèo với cậu đâu, nhưng có việc gấp phát sinh rồi.
sample: I'd hate to bail on you, but something urgent just came up.
note: Same cushioning move, personal context.

text: Slack cứ hai phút lại kêu một lần thì tập trung sao nổi.
sample: It's hard to focus when Slack pings every two minutes.
note: Names a condition that makes something difficult, not the person.

text: Tiền nhà ăn hết nửa lương thì tiết kiệm kiểu gì được.
sample: It's hard to save money when rent eats half your paycheck.
note: Same cause-and-effect shape, financial context.

text: Cả cái công cụ này sinh ra là để tiết kiệm thời gian, chứ không phải thêm bước cho rườm rà.
sample: The whole point of this tool is to save time, not add more steps.
note: Reasserts the original purpose that got lost.

text: Cả cái việc đi nghỉ là để thực sự ngắt kết nối, chứ không phải mang việc theo.
sample: The whole point of a vacation is to actually disconnect.
note: Same pattern, calls out a purpose being defeated.

text: Cứ tưởng giá rẻ thế thì đồ ăn phải dở, ai ngờ ngon bất ngờ.
sample: You'd think it'd be bad for the price, but it's actually amazing.
note: Sets up an expectation, then flips it.

text: Cứ tưởng công ty to thế này thì chuyện đó phải xử lý xong từ lâu rồi, ai ngờ vẫn chưa.
sample: You'd think a company this size would have this figured out, but they don't.
note: Same twist, applied to a bigger surprise.

text: Chắc là cô ấy bận thôi, mình không nghĩ nhiều đâu.
sample: For all I know, she's just busy — I wouldn't read into it.
note: Flags a guess as a guess, not a fact.

text: Biết đâu bị cắt vì ngân sách, chứ chưa chắc vì hiệu suất kém.
sample: For all I know, it got cut for budget reasons, not performance.
note: Same honest-uncertainty shape, workplace context.

text: Sức người có hạn, tăng ca hoài kiểu gì cũng lộ ra hết.
sample: There's only so much overtime a person can take before it shows.
note: Names a limit before it gets crossed.

text: Mình chịu bừa bộn được đến một mức thôi, quá là phải nói.
sample: There's only so much mess I can ignore before I say something.
note: Same limit-naming pattern, everyday context.

text: Nhiều khi họp xong rồi mà chẳng ai biết tại sao lại họp cái đó.
sample: Half the time, we don't even know why the meeting was scheduled.
note: Calls out how often something happens, without saying 'always'.

text: Nhiều hôm điện thoại mình hết pin trước cả giờ trưa.
sample: Half the time, my phone dies before lunch.
note: Same frequency-complaint shape, lighter tone.

text: Chỉ cần bỏ ra năm phút là xong, chứ không phải do không biết làm.
sample: It's a matter of finding five minutes, not skill.
note: Reframes a problem as about effort or time, not ability.

text: Vấn đề là có duy trì đều đặn hay không, chứ không phải có động lực hay không.
sample: It's a matter of showing up daily, not feeling motivated.
note: Same reframing shape, applied to self-discipline.

text: Hiểu cậu đang bực, nhưng viết lại bây giờ không giải quyết được gì đâu.
sample: I can see why you're frustrated, but rewriting it now isn't the fix.
note: Validates the feeling before disagreeing with the conclusion.

text: Hiểu là cậu buồn, nhưng tớ nghĩ anh ấy không cố ý đâu.
sample: I can see why you're hurt, but I don't think he meant it that way.
note: Same validate-then-push-back move, personal context.

text: Rắc rối của cái công cụ này là nó tạo thêm việc chứ chẳng tiết kiệm được gì.
sample: The trouble with this tool is it creates more work than it saves.
note: Names a flaw before explaining it — a classic setup for criticism.

text: Vấn đề của mạng xã hội là nó được thiết kế để gây nghiện, chứ không phải để giải trí.
sample: The trouble with social media is it's designed to be addictive, not fun.
note: Same pattern applied to a bigger, more abstract target.

text: Cái khiến mình khó chịu là ông ấy suốt ngày kêu ồn mà chính mình cũng làm y hệt.
sample: What gets me is he complains about noise and does the exact same thing.
note: Highlights the specific detail that's most irritating, not the whole situation.

text: Cái khiến mình ngứa mắt là sếp chẳng đụng tay vào dự án mà vẫn ngồi nhận công.
sample: What gets me is he barely touched the project and still took the credit.
note: Same pattern, workplace resentment instead of a neighbor dispute.

text: Nói gì thì nói, anh ta biểu diễn đúng là đỉnh thật.
sample: Say what you want about him, but the man can perform.
chunk: say what you want about ___, but ___
note: Concedes a criticism up front, then pivots to a genuine compliment.

text: Nói gì thì nói, cách làm việc của chị ấy lộn xộn thật nhưng deadline nào cũng kịp.
sample: Say what you want about her process, but she always hits the deadline.
chunk: say what you want about ___, but ___
note: Same concede-then-praise shape, applied to a work habit.

text: Cứ để thời gian trôi qua rồi nó sẽ không còn đau như bây giờ nữa đâu.
sample: Give it enough time and this won't hurt the way it does now.
note: Frames patience itself as the solution, not a specific action.

text: Cứ kiên nhẫn rồi khách sẽ tự tìm đến qua lời truyền tai thôi.
sample: Give it enough time and word of mouth will find them the right customers.
note: Same patience-as-solution shape, applied to a business outcome.

text: Có lý do team phải test kỹ đến vậy — lần sập hệ thống trước làm mất cả cuối tuần để khắc phục.
sample: There's a reason we test this much — the last outage cost us a weekend.
note: Justifies a habit or rule by pointing to its origin, not just defending it.

text: Có lý do mình phải kiểm tra hai lần — có lần quên tắt bếp rồi từ đó không dám chủ quan nữa.
sample: There's a reason I check twice — I left it on once and never forgot it.
note: Same justification shape, personal habit instead of a team rule.

text: Không phải tớ thấy tin nhắn cậu mà cố tình lờ đi đâu.
sample: It's not like I saw your message and chose to ignore it.
note: Denies an unfair implication before explaining what actually happened.

text: Không phải cố tình bỏ qua đâu, chỉ là chưa nhận được thông báo thôi.
sample: It's not like I skipped it deliberately — I just never got the notification.
note: Same denial shape, workplace accusation instead of a personal one.

text: Bỏ thêm chút tiền để mua thứ dùng được năm năm cũng đáng mà.
sample: It's worth spending a bit more for something that'll last five years.
note: States that the cost of something is justified by the payoff.

text: Học nấu ăn đáng lắm, tiết kiệm được cả đời còn gì.
sample: It's worth learning to cook — you'll save money for the rest of your life.
note: Same cost-justified-by-payoff shape, everyday skill instead of a purchase.

text: Đương nhiên là phải test trước khi đẩy lên production rồi, khỏi cần nói.
sample: It goes without saying that we test before we push to production.
note: Marks something as so obvious it barely needs stating — but you say it anyway.

text: Khỏi cần nói cũng biết là tớ sẽ qua giúp cậu chuyển nhà rồi.
sample: It goes without saying that I'll be there to help you move.
note: Same obvious-but-said-anyway shape, personal favor instead of a work norm.

text: Lần cuối mình kiểm tra thì quy định đó vẫn còn hiệu lực.
sample: The last time I checked, that rule was still in place.
note: Signals mild skepticism about a claim, using your own last known info.

text: Lần cuối mình check thì cái endpoint đó đã bị tắt rồi.

text: Dù quyết định thế nào thì team cũng sẽ điều chỉnh lại roadmap cho phù hợp.
sample: Either way, we'll adjust the roadmap once the decision's final.
note: Same both-outcomes-acceptable shape, applied to a business decision.

text: Kiểu gì thì kiểu, vấn đề này rồi cũng sẽ được giải quyết thôi.
sample: One way or another, this issue is going to get resolved.
note: States confidence in an outcome without committing to the exact method.

text: Kiểu gì cũng phải đưa được cái này ra mắt trước thứ Sáu.
sample: One way or another, we're getting this out the door by Friday.
note: Same outcome-confidence shape, applied to a release deadline.

text: Nhìn bề ngoài vậy thôi chứ anh ta còn nhiều điều bất ngờ lắm — hóa ra từng đi lưu diễn cùng một ban nhạc.
sample: There's more to him than meets the eye — turns out he used to tour with a band.
chunk: there's more to ___ than meets the eye
note: Signals that first impressions undersell something's real depth.

text: Con bug này không đơn giản như nhìn ban đầu đâu — hóa ra là do race condition.
sample: There's more to this bug than meets the eye — it's actually a race condition.
chunk: there's more to ___ than meets the eye
note: Same undersold-depth shape, applied to a technical problem.

text: Dù tốt hay xấu thì quyết định đó cũng đã thay đổi hoàn toàn hướng đi sự nghiệp của mình.
sample: For better or worse, that decision completely changed the direction of my career.
note: Accepts an outcome as fixed, without fully endorsing or condemning it.

text: Dù muốn hay không thì đây cũng là quy trình team đang phải chấp nhận lúc này.
sample: For better or worse, this is the process we're stuck with for now.
note: Same fixed-outcome acceptance, applied to a workplace policy.

text: Thích hay không thì đợt migrate này vẫn sẽ diễn ra vào quý tới.
sample: Like it or not, this migration is happening next quarter.
note: States a fact as true regardless of anyone's feelings about it.

text: Thích hay không thì công cụ AI cũng đang len lỏi vào mọi công việc rồi.
sample: Like it or not, AI tools are becoming part of every job.
note: Same regardless-of-feelings shape, applied to a broader trend.

text: Yêu hay ghét thì cũng phải công nhận bộ phim đó đã thay đổi cách người ta viết kịch bản sitcom.
sample: Love it or hate it, that show changed how sitcoms are written.
note: Acknowledges genuine impact despite the topic being polarizing.

text: Yêu hay ghét thì món đó vẫn là món đặc trưng của cả thành phố này.
sample: Love it or hate it, this dish is basically the city's signature food.
note: Same polarizing-but-impactful shape, applied to a local food.

text: May sao lúc đó người duy nhất biết sửa vẫn còn ở văn phòng.
sample: As luck would have it, the one person who could fix it was still in the office.
note: A classic storytelling phrase for introducing a fortunate coincidence.

text: May thế nào mà xe buýt cũng bị trễ, thế là mình vẫn kịp.
sample: As luck would have it, the bus was running late too, so I still made it.
note: Same fortunate-coincidence shape, applied to a smaller everyday story.

text: Bao nhiêu thành phố trên đời, vậy mà mình lại gặp bạn cùng phòng cũ ngay ở Tokyo.
sample: Of all the cities in the world, I ran into my old roommate in Tokyo.
note: Emphasizes how unlikely or notable one outcome is among many options.

text: Bao nhiêu ứng viên như vậy, cuối cùng họ lại chọn người ít kinh nghiệm nhất.
sample: Of all the candidates, they picked the one with the least experience.
note: Same unlikely-outcome shape, applied to a decision you disagree with.

text: Trong tất cả những cuốn sách mình đọc năm nay, cuốn đó để lại ấn tượng sâu nhất.
sample: Out of all the books I've read this year, that one stuck with me the most.
note: A structure for making a superlative claim grounded in personal experience.

text: Trong tất cả những dự án mình từng làm, dự án đó dạy mình nhiều nhất.
sample: Out of all the projects I've worked on, this one taught me the most.
note: Same grounded-superlative shape, applied to a professional experience.

text: Chưa bao giờ mình bay chuyến nào dài như thế.
sample: That's the longest flight I've ever been on.
note: Superlative + ever. Instant emphasis without any extra adjectives.

text: Đáng lẽ mình nên đặt vé sớm hơn.
sample: I should've booked earlier.
note: Regret in three syllables. Say it as “shoulda” and you sound native.

text: Giá mà mình mang ít đồ hơn.
sample: I wish I'd packed lighter.
note: Wish + past perfect = regret about the past. The grammar carries the feeling.

text: Càng đi nhiều mình càng thích đi tàu hơn bay.
sample: The more I travel, the more I prefer trains to flying.
note: Prefer takes “to”, never “than”. The one mistake everyone makes here.

text: Không phải vì xa, mà là vì đắt.
sample: It's less about the distance and more about the price.
note: Shifts the emphasis without ever saying the other person was wrong.

text: Kiểu gì mình cũng ra sân bay sớm ba tiếng.
sample: I always end up at the airport three hours early.
note: “End up” = where things land despite your intentions. Very high-frequency.

text: Thà đi sớm còn hơn phải chạy vội.
sample: I'd sooner leave early than have to rush.
note: Sooner = rather, but sharper. Both verbs stay bare — no “to”.

text: Mình định đi Đà Lạt nhưng cuối cùng lại ở nhà.
sample: I was going to go to Da Lat but ended up staying home.
note: The plan-that-died pattern. Half of all travel stories start here.

text: Đến tận lúc tới mình mới biết là mang nhiều quá.
sample: It wasn't until I got there that I realised I'd overpacked.
note: Delays the punchline. Sounds thoughtful rather than rambling.

text: Cứ mỗi lần mình bay là trời lại mưa.
sample: It never fails — I fly, it rains.
note: Announces a personal curse. The dash does all the timing work.

text: Mình chưa từng đi xa một mình bao giờ.
sample: I've never travelled far on my own before.
note: Present perfect + before. The standard first-time confession.

text: Đi được nửa đường mình mới nhớ là quên sạc.
sample: I was halfway there before I remembered I'd forgotten my charger.
note: Two past layers stacked: the journey, then the realisation.

text: Nếu biết trước thì mình đã không đặt chỗ đó.
sample: If I'd known, I wouldn't have booked that place.
chunk: if I'd known, I wouldn't have ___
note: Third conditional. Memorise the shell, swap only the ending.

text: Chỗ nào cũng được, miễn là gần biển.
sample: Anywhere's fine as long as it's near the beach.
note: One condition, stated generously. Makes you easy to travel with.

text: Cũng không tệ như mình tưởng.
sample: It wasn't as bad as I expected.
note: Comparative with a built-in opinion. Endlessly reusable.

text: Đi chơi mà cứ như đi làm.
sample: It felt more like work than a holiday.
note: Reframes something by comparison instead of describing it.

text: Bay cả chặng xa thế chỉ để ăn một bát mì.
sample: I flew all that way just for a bowl of noodles.
note: Self-mocking exaggeration. Gets a laugh every time.

text: Vừa ra khỏi cửa là trời mưa luôn.
sample: No sooner had I stepped outside than it started raining.
note: Inverted and a bit literary. Deploy it once and people notice.

text: Mình không nhớ nổi tên khách sạn.
sample: I can't for the life of me remember the hotel's name.
chunk: I can't for the life of me ___
note: Fixed idiom for total blankness. Never changes form.

text: Thật ra mình thích về nhà hơn là đi.
sample: Honestly, I like coming home more than going away.
note: Gerunds on both sides of the comparison keep it balanced.

text: Chuyến đó vừa đắt vừa mệt.
sample: It was both expensive and exhausting.
note: Pairs two complaints into one confident sentence.

text: Mình đi hơn mười nước rồi mà chưa nước nào bằng Nhật.
sample: Of all the places I've been, none beat Japan.
note: Front-loads the scope, then lands the verdict.

text: Không biết có nên ở thêm một ngày không.
sample: I'm not sure whether to stay another day or not.
note: Whether + infinitive. The polished way to think out loud.

text: Cứ tưởng gần mà đi mãi không tới.
sample: I thought it was close, but it just kept going.
note: “Just kept” stretches time. Perfect for a walk that wouldn’t end.

text: May mà mình có mua bảo hiểm du lịch.
sample: Good thing I got travel insurance.
note: Retroactive relief. Drops the “it’s a” entirely in speech.

text: Nghỉ rồi mà vẫn thấy mệt.
sample: Even after a full weekend off, I'm still tired.
note: Concession then contradiction. The shape does the complaining for you.

text: Không phải mình lười, mà là mình kiệt sức.
sample: I'm not lazy, I'm exhausted.
note: Reject-and-replace. Two words each side is enough.

text: Mình mệt đến mức không buồn ăn.
sample: I'm too tired to even eat.
note: “Even” pushes it to the extreme end. Small word, big effect.

text: Lẽ ra mình không nên để lâu thế.
sample: I shouldn't have left it this long.
note: Regret about something you did do. The mirror of “should have”.

text: Càng thức khuya thì sáng càng mệt.
sample: However late I stay up, I pay for it the next morning.
note: However + adjective front-loads the concession. Sounds fluent fast.

text: Cứ ngồi lâu là lưng mình lại đau.
sample: If I sit too long, my back starts up again.
note: For recurring pain or noise. Implies a long history in two words.

text: Với mình đi bộ còn hơn tập gym.
sample: Walking beats the gym for me any day.
note: Comparison as a verdict. Confident and completely idiomatic.

text: Người mình như bị xe tải đâm.
sample: I feel like I've been hit by a truck.
note: Fixed simile for total wreckage. Nobody takes it literally.

text: Giờ mình khoẻ hơn hồi ba mươi.
sample: I'm in better shape than I was at thirty.
note: Shape = physical condition. Also “out of shape”, “in great shape”.

text: Không ngủ được thì làm gì cũng khó.
sample: Nothing works when you're not sleeping.
note: Generalises with “you” instead of “I”. Sounds wiser, less whiny.

text: Uống thuốc là đỡ ngay.
sample: It cleared up as soon as I started the medication.
note: Illnesses, rashes, weather and misunderstandings all clear up.

text: Mình vừa mệt vừa lo, hết pin rồi.
sample: I'm running on empty.
chunk: no gas left in the tank
note: Fuel metaphor for a person. Instantly understood everywhere.

text: Mình mới tập lại được hai tuần.
sample: I've only been back at it for two weeks.
note: Returning to a habit. Vague on purpose about what “it” is.

text: Không có gì nghiêm trọng đâu.
sample: It's nothing serious.
note: The reassurance sentence. Learn it before you need it.

text: Mình chưa bao giờ đau như vậy.
sample: I've never felt pain like that.
note: Present perfect + “like that” points back at a specific moment.

text: Đi ngủ sớm là việc dễ nhất mà mình không làm được.
sample: Going to bed early is the one thing I can't seem to do.
note: “Seem to” admits failure gently, as if it weren’t your fault.

text: Cả tuần mới hết hẳn.
sample: It took a full week to shake it off.
note: Shake off a cold, a mood, a bad game. Recovery by effort.

text: Không cà phê thì mình chịu được ba ngày là cùng.
sample: Three days is about my limit without coffee.
note: States a boundary with a number. Funny and honest at once.

text: Mình chẳng còn sức mà tập nữa.
sample: I haven't got the energy to train.
note: British “haven’t got” for possession. Shorter than “I do not have”.

text: Khỏi rồi mới thấy trước đó tệ thế nào.
sample: You only realise how bad it was once it's gone.
note: Hindsight pattern. Sounds thoughtful in any conversation.

text: Ăn uống thế nào thì người thế ấy.
sample: You get out what you put in.
chunk: you get out what you put in
note: Gym proverb that works for work and study too.

text: Ngủ đủ tám tiếng mà vẫn buồn ngủ.
sample: Eight hours and I'm still shattered.
note: Bare noun + “and” skips the whole clause. Very spoken.

text: Tập xong là đầu óc nhẹ hẳn.
sample: I always think more clearly after a workout.
note: Comparative adverb. Not “think clearer” in careful speech.

text: Mình bỏ tập từ tháng ba.
sample: I haven't trained since March.
note: Since + point in time. For + duration. The classic pair.

text: Cứ bảo là không sao nhưng rõ ràng là có.
sample: He keeps saying he's fine, but he clearly isn't.
note: Bare negative auxiliary at the end. Efficient and a bit damning.

text: Tiêu bao nhiêu cũng hết.
sample: However much I earn, it somehow all goes.
note: “Somehow” blames nobody and everybody. Perfect for money.

text: Không phải mình không có tiền, mà là mình không muốn tiêu.
sample: It's not that I can't afford it, I just don't want to.
chunk: it's not that I can't ___, I just ___
note: Separates ability from choice. Ends the pressure instantly.

text: Đắt thì đắt nhưng dùng được mười năm.
sample: It's expensive, but it'll last ten years.
note: Price versus lifespan. The whole buy-it-once argument in one line.

text: Mình càng kiếm được thì càng tiêu nhiều.
sample: The more I earn, the more I spend.
chunk: the more I earn, the more I ___
note: Parallel comparatives. Sounds wry rather than complaining.

text: Thà mua một cái tốt còn hơn ba cái rẻ.
sample: One good one is worth three cheap ones.
note: Worth as a verdict on value. No verb gymnastics needed.

text: Mua rồi mới thấy không cần.
sample: I only realised I didn't need it after I'd bought it.
note: Regret with a timeline. Extremely relatable in any language.

text: Cứ tưởng rẻ mà cộng vào thì đắt.
sample: It looks cheap until you add it all up.
note: Sets up an illusion and then breaks it. Great for prices.

text: Mình chẳng bao giờ mua gì mà không xem giá ba chỗ.
sample: I never buy anything without checking three places first.
note: Negative + without = a rule you live by. Sounds disciplined.

text: Tiền nào của ấy.
sample: You get what you pay for.
chunk: you get what you pay for
note: Word-for-word equivalent of the Vietnamese proverb. Use freely.

text: Mình để dành được đồng nào là tiêu hết đồng đó.
sample: Every time I save a bit, something breaks.
note: The universal law of household finance, stated as a pattern.

text: Không đáng để mất bằng ấy tiền.
sample: It's not worth that kind of money.
note: Vague-but-heavy amount. Judges a price without naming it.

text: Mình phải tính từng đồng đến cuối tháng.
sample: I'm counting every penny until payday.
note: Fixed idiom for being broke but coping. No shame attached.

text: Mua cái đó là quyết định sáng suốt nhất năm.
sample: Best money I've spent all year.
note: Superlative with “money” as the subject. Compliments a purchase.

text: Mình chưa bao giờ hối hận vì mua sách.
sample: I've never once regretted buying a book.
note: “Once” sharpens the never. Small word, much stronger claim.

text: Rẻ mà dùng được thì kể cả xấu cũng chấp nhận.
sample: If it's cheap and it works, I can live with ugly.
note: Accepts a downside deliberately. Sounds pragmatic, not fussy.

text: Mình tiêu vào đồ ăn nhiều hơn cả tiền nhà.
sample: I spend more on food than I do on rent.
note: Spend takes “on” for the thing bought. Never “spend for”.

text: Lúc cần thì chẳng bao giờ có sẵn.
sample: It’s never there when you actually need it.
note: “Actually” adds the frustration. Works for money, keys, taxis.

text: Đằng nào cũng phải mua, mua sớm còn rẻ.
sample: I'll have to buy one anyway, so it may as well be now.
note: Resigned logic. The phrase that ends most shopping debates.

text: Mình thắt chặt được ba tuần là cùng.
sample: I can be careful for about three weeks, then it collapses.
note: Self-aware punchline. Admits the pattern rather than the failure.

text: Nếu mình không mua thì giờ đã đủ tiền đi Nhật.
sample: If I hadn't bought it, I'd have that trip to Japan by now.
note: Third conditional applied to money. Painful and very fluent.

text: Cái gì rẻ quá thì nên nghĩ lại.
sample: If it's that cheap, there's usually a reason.
chunk: if it's that ___, there's usually a reason
note: Suspicion pattern. Also works for deals, offers and job ads.

text: Tiêu thì dễ, kiếm thì khó.
sample: Spending is easy, earning isn't.
note: Bare negative auxiliary at the end. Tight and rhythmical.

text: Mình mua vì nó giảm giá, chứ không phải vì cần.
sample: I bought it because it was on offer, not because I needed it.
note: Confesses the real reason. Honest and structurally neat.

text: Đến giờ mình vẫn chưa dùng cái máy đó lần nào.
sample: I still haven't used it once.
note: “Still” plus “once” is maximum self-indictment.

text: Cứ để dành mãi mà chẳng thấy tăng.
sample: No matter how much I put aside, it never seems to grow.
note: Concessive clause. Idiomatic and slightly weary.

text: Càng phỏng vấn nhiều mình càng bớt sợ.
sample: The more interviews I do, the less nervous I get.
note: Opposite-direction comparatives. Very common and easy to reuse.

text: Không phải mình không thích công việc, chỉ là mình muốn học thêm.
sample: It's not the job I've got a problem with, it's the ceiling.
chunk: it's not ___ I've got a problem with, it's ___
note: Redirects the complaint precisely. Diplomatic and clear.

text: Nếu mình không nhận việc đó thì giờ vẫn còn ở Hà Nội.
sample: If I hadn't taken that job, I'd still be in Hanoi.
chunk: if I hadn't ___, I'd still be ___
note: Mixed conditional: past cause, present result. Very fluent.

text: Mình làm ở đó lâu đến mức quên mất mình từng giỏi cái gì.
sample: I was there so long I forgot what I was good at.
note: Result clause without “that”. Sounds spoken, not written.

text: Thà bị từ chối còn hơn không thử.
sample: I'd rather be turned down than not apply.
note: Passive for rejection. Keeps the focus on your own choice.

text: Mình chưa từng được phản hồi thẳng thắn như vậy.
sample: Nobody had ever given me feedback that direct before.
note: Past perfect for the moment before a change. Sets up a story.

text: Đi làm rồi mới biết bằng đại học chẳng dạy gì.
sample: It wasn't until I started working that I saw what the degree missed.
note: Hindsight about education. Honest without being bitter.

text: Mình vừa muốn ổn định vừa muốn thử cái mới.
sample: Part of me wants stability and part of me wants a fight.
chunk: part of me wants ___ and part of me wants ___
note: Splits yourself in two. Sounds reflective rather than indecisive.

text: Kinh nghiệm của mình chủ yếu là tự học.
sample: Most of what I know, I taught myself.
chunk: most of what I know, I ___
note: Fronted object for emphasis. Confident and slightly proud.

text: Mình không giỏi nhất nhưng mình không bỏ cuộc.
sample: I'm not the sharpest in the room, but I don't leave problems unfinished.
note: Concede one thing, claim a better one. A very strong move.

text: Được thăng chức mà việc thì nhiều hơn gấp đôi.
sample: The title changed; the workload doubled.
note: Two bare clauses with a semicolon. Dry and very effective.

text: Mình mất ba tháng mới tìm được việc.
sample: It took me three months to find anything.
note: Impersonal “it” + duration. The standard way to report effort.

text: Cứ nghĩ mình chưa đủ giỏi để ứng tuyển.
sample: I kept telling myself I wasn't ready yet.
note: Names the internal voice. Extremely relatable in interviews.

text: Đồng nghiệp tốt quan trọng hơn lương cao.
sample: Good colleagues beat a good salary, every time.
note: Adverbial at the end hammers the verdict home.

text: Mình học được nhiều từ ông ấy hơn cả bốn năm đại học.
sample: I learnt more from him in one year than in four at university.
note: Comparison across two time spans. Precise and persuasive.

text: Mình không hối hận vì đã nghỉ.
sample: Leaving is the one decision I've never second-guessed.
note: Superlative-by-uniqueness. Stronger than “I don’t regret it”.

text: Việc đó nghe hay nhưng làm thì khác.
sample: It sounded a lot better on the job description.
note: Compares promise with reality. Wry, and universally understood.

text: Mình chỉ giỏi hơn hôm qua một chút.
sample: I'm slightly better than I was yesterday, and that's the whole plan.
note: Undersells ambition in a way that sounds very confident.

text: Mình được nhận không phải vì giỏi nhất mà vì chuẩn bị kỹ nhất.
sample: I didn't get it for being the best — I got it for being the most prepared.
chunk: I didn't get it for ___ — I got it for ___
note: Correction structure with a lesson inside it.

text: Lúc nào mình cũng thấy chưa đủ kinh nghiệm.
sample: However long I do this, I still feel like I just started.
chunk: I still feel like I just ___
note: Impostor syndrome in one sentence. Instantly relatable.

text: Đi phỏng vấn cũng là một cách học.
sample: Every interview teaches you something, even the bad ones.
note: Tag on the end that softens and completes the claim.

text: Mình không muốn làm quản lý.
sample: Management isn’t the goal for me — it’s just one road.
note: Rejects an assumption without rejecting the person asking.

text: Mình đã nộp bốn mươi chỗ mới được một lời mời.
sample: Forty applications, one offer — that’s just the maths of it.
chunk: that's just the maths of it
note: Normalises rejection with arithmetic. Removes the shame.

text: Càng lên cao thì càng ít viết code.
sample: The higher you go, the less you actually build.
chunk: the higher you go, the less ___
note: Ladder observation. Sounds experienced and slightly rueful.

text: Nếu được chọn lại mình vẫn chọn nghề này.
sample: Given the choice again, I'd do the same thing.
note: Compact conditional. Three words replace a whole clause.

text: Không phải mình không muốn giúp, mà là mình không kịp.
sample: It's not that I won't, it's that I can't this week.
chunk: it's not that I won't, it's that I can't
note: Separates willingness from capacity. Ends most guilt-trips.

text: Càng nói nhiều thì càng khó gỡ.
sample: The more we talk about it, the worse it gets.
note: Comparative + “gets” for deterioration. Signals it is time to stop.

text: Mình chịu được tất cả trừ việc bị nói dối.
sample: I can handle most things, but not being lied to.
note: Draws the line by contrast. Memorable and very firm.

text: Đáng lẽ bạn nên nói với mình trước.
sample: You could have just told me.
note: “Just” makes the alternative sound effortless. Quietly devastating.

text: Mình nói rồi nhưng chẳng ai nghe.
sample: I did say, for what it's worth.
note: Adds a mild I-told-you-so. Deniable, and lands anyway.

text: Cứ mỗi lần mình nhắc là bạn lại đổi chủ đề.
sample: Every time I raise it, we end up talking about something else.
note: Describes the pattern rather than accusing. Harder to deny.

text: Mình không phải người duy nhất thấy thế.
sample: It's not just me who thinks that.
note: Adds weight without naming anyone. Use carefully.

text: Nếu bạn nói sớm thì đã không thành ra thế này.
sample: If you'd said something earlier, none of this would have happened.
chunk: none of this would have happened
note: Third conditional as a verdict. Very strong, so pick your moment.

text: Mình xin lỗi nhưng mình vẫn giữ ý kiến.
sample: I'm sorry it landed badly, but I stand by it.
note: Apologises for the impact, not the position. A precise distinction.

text: Bạn đang biến chuyện nhỏ thành chuyện lớn.
sample: You're making this bigger than it needs to be.
chunk: bigger than it needs to be
note: Names the escalation without escalating yourself.

text: Mình không nhớ mình đã đồng ý chuyện đó.
sample: I don't remember agreeing to that.
note: Disputes a claim politely. Leaves space for you to be wrong.

text: Vấn đề không phải cái đó, mà là thái độ.
sample: It was never about the task — it was about how you said it.
chunk: it was never about ___ — it was about ___
note: Relocates the argument to the real issue.

text: Mình đã nhường quá nhiều lần rồi.
sample: I've let it go too many times already.
chunk: let it go too many times
note: Explains why this time is different. Justifies the whole conversation.

text: Bạn cứ nói thế nhưng làm khác.
sample: You say that, and then you do the opposite.
chunk: and then you do the opposite
note: Bare contrast. Requires no adjective to sting.

text: Mình thà bị nói xấu còn hơn im lặng.
sample: I'd sooner be unpopular than quiet about it.
note: Chooses a cost openly. Reads as integrity, not stubbornness.

text: Chuyện này không phải lần đầu.
sample: This isn't the first time, and that's the problem.
note: Tag that turns an observation into an argument.

text: Mình không cần bạn đồng ý, chỉ cần bạn hiểu.
sample: I don't need you to agree, I just need you to get it.
chunk: I don't need you to ___, I just need you to ___
note: Lowers the demand to something achievable. Often unlocks the deadlock.

text: Nói ra thì mất lòng mà không nói thì mệt mình.
sample: Saying it costs me the peace; not saying it costs me more.
note: Weighs two costs in one sentence. Sounds thoughtful and final.

text: Mình chỉ muốn được hỏi trước.
sample: All I wanted was to be asked first.
note: Reduces the whole conflict to one small, reasonable thing.

text: Không ai đúng hoàn toàn đâu.
sample: Nobody's completely in the right here, me included.
note: Two words that make a concession credible.

text: Bạn nói thế là không công bằng với mình.
sample: That's not a fair thing to say to me.
chunk: that's not a fair thing to ___
note: Judges the statement, not the speaker. Keeps it survivable.

text: Mình sẽ không xin lỗi vì chuyện mình không làm.
sample: I'm not apologising for something I didn't do.
note: Refuses a false apology. Firm, and completely defensible.

text: Chuyện qua rồi, mình không nhắc nữa.
sample: It's done. I'm not dragging it back up.
note: Closes the topic and promises not to reopen it.

text: Bạn muốn mình nói thẳng hay nói nhẹ?
sample: Do you want it straight or gently?
note: Hands them the choice. Makes hard feedback consensual.

text: Mình không thắng cuộc này nhưng mình đã nói được.
sample: I didn't win that, but at least I said it.
note: Consolation tag. Reframes a loss as a small victory.

text: Càng cố vui thì càng thấy tệ.
sample: The harder I try to be cheerful, the worse I feel.
chunk: the harder I try to ___, the worse ___
note: Effort-versus-result comparatives. Very natural in complaints.

text: Không phải mình buồn, chỉ là mình mệt trong đầu.
sample: It's not sadness exactly, it's more like static.
chunk: it's not ___ exactly, it's more like ___
note: Reaches for a better word mid-sentence. Sounds authentic.

text: Mình ổn cho đến khi ai đó hỏi.
sample: I was completely fine until somebody asked.
note: The moment the feeling arrived. Sets up a whole story.

text: Mình cứ nghĩ chỉ mình như thế.
sample: I always assumed it was just me.
note: Past habit of belief. Perfect for a small revelation.

text: Nghe bạn kể mình cũng thấy nghẹn.
sample: Hearing you say that put a lump in my throat.
note: The physical sign of being moved. Fixed and vivid.

text: Mình thà bận còn hơn phải ngồi nghĩ.
sample: I'd sooner be busy than left alone with my head.
note: Striking image for rumination. Very quotable.

text: Đến giờ mình vẫn chưa hết bàng hoàng.
sample: It still hasn't quite sunk in.
note: For news too big to process. Works for good and bad alike.

text: Mình vui đến mức muốn khóc.
sample: I was so happy I nearly cried.
note: Intensity through consequence. Simplest emphasis pattern in English.

text: Nếu không có bạn thì mình chẳng qua nổi.
sample: I don't know how I'd have got through it without you.
chunk: I don't know how I'd have ___ without you
note: The strongest thanks in the language. Use it rarely.

text: Mình cứ tưởng mình quên rồi.
sample: I thought I was over it, apparently not.
note: Two-word reversal. Wry and completely natural.

text: Mình không giỏi nói về cảm xúc.
sample: I'm not very good at this kind of conversation.
note: Admits the difficulty and continues anyway. Endearing.

text: Càng để lâu càng khó nói.
sample: The longer I leave it, the harder it gets to say.
chunk: the longer I leave it, the harder ___
note: Explains a delay. Often the first sentence of a confession.

text: Mình thấy khá hơn nhiều so với tháng trước.
sample: I'm nowhere near where I was last month.
note: Distance as progress. Optimistic without being fake.

text: Chỉ cần ai đó lắng nghe là đủ.
sample: Sometimes you just want someone to sit there and not fix it.
chunk: sit there and not fix it
note: Names what support actually means. Hugely useful sentence.

text: Mình cảm thấy như đang diễn.
sample: Half the time I feel like I’m performing being fine.
note: Unusual and precise. The kind of line people remember.

text: Mình mất một lúc mới hiểu mình đang giận.
sample: It took me a while to work out I was angry.
chunk: it took me a while to work out ___
note: Delayed self-awareness. Very honest, very common.

text: Không ai hỏi thì mình cũng không nói.
sample: I'd never have brought it up if you hadn't asked.
chunk: I'd never have ___ if you hadn't ___
note: Third conditional in speech. Credits the other person.

text: Mình thấy biết ơn những chuyện nhỏ.
sample: It's the small things I'm most grateful for.
note: Cleft sentence for emphasis. Sounds reflective and warm.

text: Mình khóc xong thì thấy nhẹ hẳn.
sample: I had a cry and felt weirdly better.
note: Adverb + comparative. Captures a feeling that resists explanation.

text: Mình sợ nhất là làm người khác thất vọng.
sample: The thing I dread most is letting people down.
chunk: the thing I dread most is ___
note: Names a fear with structure. Sounds composed, not fragile.

text: Mình không cần lời khuyên, chỉ cần được nghe.
sample: I wasn't looking for solutions, just a bit of company.
note: Corrects the help you are being given. Kind but clear.

text: Cảm giác như trút được gánh nặng.
sample: It felt like putting down something heavy.
note: Fresh metaphor for relief. Better than any adjective.

text: Mình vẫn chưa sẵn sàng nói chuyện đó.
sample: I'm not ready to go into that yet.
note: Go into = discuss in detail. Declines without shutting down.

text: Mình vừa mừng vừa lo.
sample: I'm equal parts excited and terrified.
note: Holds two feelings at once. Neat, memorable, very reusable.

text: Cứ nghĩ đến là mình lại thấy ấm lòng.
sample: I still think about it and it still gets me.
note: Present tense for a lasting effect. Simple and moving.

text: Càng họp nhiều thì càng ít làm được việc.
sample: The more meetings I have, the less I actually get done.
chunk: the less I actually get done
note: Comparative complaint. Universally agreed with in any office.

text: Không phải mình phản đối, mình chỉ muốn hiểu rõ.
sample: I'm not pushing back, I'm just trying to understand it.
chunk: I'm not ___ing, I'm just trying to ___
note: Disarms the reading of your question before anyone makes it.

text: Cuộc họp này đáng lẽ chỉ cần một email.
sample: This could have been an email.
note: Modern office proverb. Say it only among friends.

text: Mình nói xong rồi mới nhớ ra số liệu.
sample: I remembered the number the second I sat down.
note: Comic timing built into the sentence.

text: Ai cũng đồng ý nhưng chẳng ai làm.
sample: Everyone agreed, and nothing happened.
note: Bare contrast, no commentary needed. Quietly damning.

text: Mình thà nói thẳng trong họp còn hơn nhắn riêng.
sample: I'd sooner say it in the room than in a DM.
note: Signals directness as a value. Earns a lot of trust.

text: Nếu mình chuẩn bị kỹ hơn thì đã không bị hỏi khó.
sample: If I'd prepared properly, that question wouldn't have caught me out.
note: Caught out = exposed unprepared. Very common and useful.

text: Mình chưa bao giờ thấy buổi họp nào hiệu quả như thế.
sample: I've never been in a meeting that tight.
chunk: I've never been in a ___ that ___
note: Superlative by comparison. Works as praise or complaint.

text: Nói ít mà đúng còn hơn nói nhiều.
sample: One good point beats ten minutes of talking.
note: Comparison as advice. Sounds experienced.

text: Mình sợ nhất là bị gọi tên khi chưa chuẩn bị.
sample: The thing I dread is being put on the spot.
note: Named and shared by everyone. Instantly relatable.

text: Họp xong mình chẳng biết ai làm gì.
sample: We finished without knowing who owns what.
note: Compact and precise. The diagnosis of every bad meeting.

text: Mình cứ định nói mà không xen vào được.
sample: I kept waiting for a gap that never came.
note: Explains your silence without any self-blame.

text: Mình nghĩ ta nên quyết trước khi bàn tiếp.
sample: Let's decide first and discuss the detail after.
note: Reorders the meeting. Often saves half an hour.

text: Càng đông người thì càng khó quyết.
sample: The bigger the room, the harder the decision.
note: Elegant parallel comparatives, no verbs required.

text: Mình đã nói từ tuần trước rồi.
sample: I did flag this last week, for the record.
note: Claims the earlier warning without gloating. Use sparingly.

text: Thà họp mười lăm phút mà rõ ràng.
sample: Fifteen focused minutes beats an hour of this.
note: Concrete alternative. Turns a complaint into a proposal.

text: Mình không nghe rõ nhưng không dám hỏi lại.
sample: I didn't catch it and I was too proud to ask twice.
note: Honest, funny, and extremely human.

text: Chốt được rồi thì mình mừng lắm.
sample: Genuinely glad we landed that one.
note: Land = reach a conclusion. Warm and idiomatic.

text: Cứ mỗi lần trình bày là mình lại run.
sample: I still get nervous every single time I present.
note: “Single” intensifies “every”. Small addition, real emphasis.

text: Mình nói chậm lại thì người ta nghe hơn.
sample: I get listened to more when I slow down.
note: Passive with “get”. Very spoken, very natural.

text: Không ai đọc tài liệu trước cả.
sample: Nobody had read it, as usual.
note: Two words of resignation. Does the whole eye-roll for you.

text: Mình muốn kết thúc sớm năm phút.
sample: Shall we give everyone five minutes back?
note: Framing brevity as a gift. Always popular.

text: Trình bày xong mình mới thấy run hết người.
sample: The shaking only started once I sat down.
note: Delayed reaction. A precise and vivid detail.

text: Mình thấy buổi họp này không cần mình.
sample: I'm not sure I needed to be in that one.
chunk: I'm not sure I needed to ___
note: Hedged and safe. A polite way to reclaim your calendar.

text: Càng chuẩn bị thì càng bớt sợ.
sample: The more I prepare, the less I panic.
note: Simple, true, and a very reusable second half.

text: Càng gọi nhiều thì càng chẳng ai giải quyết.
sample: The more I call, the less anybody seems to know.
note: Comparative complaint with a hedge. Weary and precise.

text: Không phải mình khó tính, mà là chuyện này sai thật.
sample: I'm not being difficult — this is genuinely wrong.
note: Pre-empts the label before they can reach for it.

text: Mình chờ bốn mươi phút rồi mà vẫn chưa tới lượt.
sample: Forty minutes on hold and I'm still in the queue.
note: Bare number plus “and” for a complaint. Very spoken.

text: Nếu họ đọc email của mình thì đã xong từ tuần trước.
sample: If they'd read my email, this would have been over last week.
chunk: if they'd read ___, this would have been ___
note: Third conditional as a complaint. Sharp, and grammatically impressive.

text: Mỗi người nói một kiểu khác nhau.
sample: Every person I speak to tells me something different.
note: Names the inconsistency. The core frustration of bureaucracy.

text: Mình thà tự đến còn hơn gọi điện.
sample: I'd sooner go in person than sit on the phone.
note: Contrast between two channels. Very natural and current.

text: Cứ tưởng xong rồi thì lại có giấy khác.
sample: Every time I think it’s done, another form appears.
note: The comic inevitability of paperwork. Universally recognised.

text: Mình chưa bao giờ thấy thủ tục nào nhanh như thế.
sample: I've never had anything sorted that quickly.
chunk: I've never had anything ___ that quickly
note: Causative “have” plus a superlative. Works as genuine praise.

text: Nói mãi mà chẳng ai chịu trách nhiệm.
sample: Nobody wants to put their name to it.
note: Vivid image of avoided accountability. Slightly damning.

text: Mình đã làm đúng hết mọi bước rồi.
sample: I've done everything they asked, to the letter.
note: Exactly as instructed. Strengthens any complaint enormously.

text: Chờ mãi rồi cũng xong.
sample: It got there in the end, at least.
note: Resigned relief. The natural close to a long saga.

text: Mình gọi lại lần thứ tư rồi.
sample: This is the fourth time I've rung about it.
note: Counting attempts. The strongest polite pressure available.

text: Càng đơn giản thì họ càng làm phức tạp.
sample: The simpler the request, the more forms they find.
note: Parallel comparatives with no verbs. Elegant and funny.

text: Mình ghi lại hết ngày giờ rồi.
sample: I've kept a note of every date and name.
note: Signals you are organised. Changes how you are treated.

text: Thà nói thẳng là không được còn hơn để mình chờ.
sample: I'd rather be told no than left waiting.
note: Past participle as a state. Compact and quietly pointed.

text: Mình chẳng hiểu tại sao lại cần giấy đó.
sample: I still don't see why they need it.
note: “Still” signals you have asked before. Adds weight politely.

text: Mất cả buổi sáng chỉ để đổi một chữ.
sample: A whole morning gone, to change one letter.
note: Noun phrase with no verb. Dry, efficient, very natural.

text: Lần sau mình sẽ gửi thư bảo đảm.
sample: Next time I'm sending it recorded delivery.
note: Present continuous for a firm future decision. Sounds resolved.

text: Người cuối cùng thì lại rất tử tế.
sample: The last one I got through to was lovely, actually.
note: Get through to = reach on the phone. Essential phrasal verb.

text: Mình không biết phải hỏi ai nữa.
sample: I've run out of people to ask.
note: Exhaustion expressed structurally. Clear and slightly funny.

text: Cái gì cũng cần bản gốc.
sample: Everything has to be the original — no copies.
note: Tag on the end that adds the rule. Very economical.

text: Mình vừa gửi đi thì họ gọi.
sample: I'd barely posted it when they rang.
note: Past perfect with “barely”. Advanced, and completely natural.

text: Ai cũng bảo không phải việc của mình.
sample: Everyone says it's not their department.
note: The single most quoted line in bureaucracy.

text: Xong rồi mà mình vẫn không tin.
sample: It's done, and I still don't quite believe it.
chunk: I still don't quite believe it
note: Relief that hasn’t landed yet. Very human.

text: Mình học được là phải ghi âm lại.
sample: What I learnt is to write down who I spoke to.
note: Cleft sentence delivering a lesson. Sounds wise and considered.

text: Càng ăn càng thấy ngon.
sample: It gets better with every bite.
note: Progressive improvement, compactly stated.

text: Không phải mình kén ăn, mình chỉ không thích rau mùi.
sample: I'm not fussy, I just draw the line at coriander.
note: Names the one exception. Sounds reasonable rather than picky.

text: Ăn ở đây một lần là nhớ mãi.
sample: You eat there once and you never forget it.
note: Second-person generalisation. Turns your opinion into a rule.

text: Mình có thể ăn cái này cả ngày.
sample: I could eat this every day and not get bored.
note: Tag that upgrades any compliment. Very natural.

text: Đáng lẽ mình không nên ăn miếng cuối.
sample: I shouldn't have had that last one.
note: Regret, food edition. The most-used sentence after any meal.

text: Nếu biết ngon thế thì mình đã gọi hai phần.
sample: If I'd known it was that good, I'd have ordered two.
chunk: if I'd known it was that good
note: Third conditional as a compliment. Grammatically impressive.

text: Mình thà ăn cơm nhà còn hơn ra tiệm sang.
sample: I'd sooner have my mum's cooking than anything with a tablecloth.
note: Wry metonymy for fancy restaurants. Very memorable.

text: Mình chưa từng ăn món nào lạ như thế.
sample: I've never eaten anything quite like it.
note: “Quite” makes the claim precise rather than exaggerated.

text: Nhìn thì bình thường mà ăn thì tuyệt.
sample: It looks like nothing and tastes incredible.
note: Sets up the contrast. The best way to recommend street food.

text: Mình ăn xong mới thấy mình đói thế nào.
sample: I hadn't realised how hungry I was until I started.
note: Past perfect for delayed awareness. Sounds very fluent.

text: Món này ăn nóng mới ngon.
sample: It's only worth eating hot.
note: Conditional value in five words. Practical and idiomatic.

text: Mình nấu ăn không bằng mẹ nhưng cũng tạm.
sample: I'll never cook like my mum, but I get by.
note: Modest competence. A very useful and likeable admission.

text: Cứ ăn hàng là mình lại tiêu quá.
sample: Every time we eat out, the bill surprises me.
note: Understatement doing the complaining. Dry and funny.

text: Đồ ăn ở đây vừa rẻ vừa ngon.
sample: It's cheap, it's good, and there's always a queue.
note: Three-part list where the last part is the proof.

text: Mình no đến mức không đứng lên được.
sample: I'm too full to move.
note: Fixed exaggeration. Everyone says it, nobody means it literally.

text: Nấu cho người khác vui hơn nấu cho mình.
sample: Cooking for one is the least fun cooking there is.
note: Superlative with “there is”. Neat and quietly sad.

text: Mình chỉ cần bát mì là đủ.
sample: Give me a bowl of noodles and I’m happy.
note: Imperative-plus-result. Warm, simple, endlessly adaptable.

text: Ăn rồi mới biết mình nhớ vị này.
sample: One bite and I was straight back home.
note: Food as time travel. Very evocative in a few words.

text: Mình không ăn được món đó nữa sau lần đó.
sample: I've not been able to touch it since.
chunk: I've not been able to touch ___ since
note: “Touch” for food you now avoid. Implies the whole story.

text: Càng đơn giản thì càng khó nấu ngon.
sample: The simpler the dish, the harder it is to do well.
chunk: the harder it is to do well
note: Chef’s truth, elegantly parallel.

text: Mình ăn hết mà chẳng kịp chụp ảnh.
sample: It was gone before anyone thought to take a photo.
note: Speed expressed through consequence. Very modern joke.

text: Mình thích quán bình dân hơn quán sang.
sample: Give me a plastic stool over a white tablecloth.
note: States a preference by image. Confident and vivid.

text: Ăn nhiều quá thì món nào cũng thường.
sample: Eat it every week and even that becomes ordinary.
note: Generalisation with a slightly melancholy edge.

text: Mình đã thử nấu ba lần mà vẫn không giống.
sample: Three attempts in and it still isn't right.
note: “In” marks progress through a process. Compact and natural.

text: Bữa cơm gia đình là thứ mình nhớ nhất.
sample: What I miss most is everyone eating at once.
note: Cleft sentence delivering real feeling. Very strong.

text: Càng lớn mình càng giống bố.
sample: The older I get, the more I turn into my father.
note: Comparative pair plus a joke everyone recognises.

text: Không phải mình không quan tâm, mình chỉ không biết nói.
sample: It's not that I don't care, I've just never been good at saying it.
chunk: I've just never been good at ___
note: Explains emotional silence. Very honest and very common.

text: Mình nhớ nhà nhất vào buổi tối.
sample: It's the evenings I miss home most.
note: Cleft sentence pinpointing a feeling. Sounds thoughtful.

text: Nếu không có anh ấy thì mình đã bỏ học.
sample: If it weren't for my brother, I'd have dropped out.
note: Compact conditional. The strongest way to credit someone.

text: Mẹ mình nói câu nào cũng đúng.
